attributes.action: Sign Now: Fix London’s Failing Transport – Reliable, Cheaper, 24/7!
attributes.additional_details:
Delays and overcrowding waste millions of hours, draining the UK economy. Fares are a crushing burden: a Zone 1-4 Travelcard (~£246/mo) takes 14% of low-income pay, forcing families to choose between travel and food. Unreliable buses isolate the most vulnerable.
We demand:
Fare Reform: Link prices to median wages to protect budgets.
Accountability: Set binding reliability targets for all lines.Sign now for a fairer system!
attributes.background: We call on the Government and TfL  to urgently improve London's transport. Operational reports  show constant delays and overcrowding on the Tube, Overground, and buses. Millions face daily congestion. We need better reliability, capacity, and night travel now.

rejection.details: This is fundamentally the responsibility of the mayor of London & the London Assembly, together with TFL
